items.name: Musical Instrument, Masterwork
items.description:
If you want to perform using a @Compendium[pf1.skills.HhV5UmaRLTjtB3Xh]{Perform} skill associated with a musical instrument (keyboard, percussion, string, or wind), you must have an appropriate musical instrument; otherwise you can't use the skill. The listed cost and weight is for a typical small instrument you could carry by hand, such as a drum, lyre, bell, harp, or flute; larger instruments such as a cello or piano are of course larger and more expensive.

This high-quality instrument grants

items.name: Outfit, Entertainer's
items.description:
Source PZO1110

This set of flashy-perhaps even gaudy-clothes is for entertaining. While the outfit looks whimsical, its practical design lets you tumble, dance, walk a tightrope, or just run (if the audience turns ugly).
